input_convention.fc_cube_equivalent_mpa: Cube-equivalent concrete strength. If a cylinder strength is used, the optional modelling approximation is fcu_eq = fc_cyl / 0.80; this is not a universal conversion.

limitations: Research prototype only; not a structural-design or safety-verification tool.
Passing marginal range checks does not establish multivariate support or safe interpolation.
The model does not provide a resistance lower bound, a calibrated safety factor, or guaranteed error for an individual estimate.
External-source evaluation showed systematic overprediction; do not use this result as a design resistance.
